Superlative fine dining experience
Feb 2026 • Couples
Fine dining in the heart of Duong Dong. What can we say,each of the 2 starters, 2 mains and dessert ordered were presented beautifully and tasted phenomenal, coupled with a bottle of san Pellegrino. Finally, a sparkling water, as well as the first palatable rose encountered in SEA. Service was professional and discrete. Sunset views were stunning. More expensive than the average restaurant in PhuQuov, but this is no average restaurant. Absolutely wonderful. Not an everday place, but definitely for a special occasion. Nothing negative to report from this establishment. We wish them well !
